question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: On the Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26 2026) management explicitly said non-GAAP GM bottoms at 71-72% in Q4 FY27 due to memory costs, recovering to 72-73% in FY28. NVIDIA guides as midpoint +/-50bp and GAAP has equaled non-GAAP in recent guides (Q3: 74.0% both). So the modal outcome is a 71.5% GAAP midpoint. Risks: further memory inflation pushing to 71.0, earlier price increases lifting to 72.0, or a small GAAP below non-GAAP gap. Polymarket only prices Q3 actual adjusted GM (73-75% at 0.79, consistent with the 74% guide), not Q4 guidance, so it's not an anchor; no matching market found.

- Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26 2026): Q2 GAAP GM 75.0%, non-GAAP 75.0%; Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP and non-GAAP GM 74.0% +/-50bp; revenue $108.0B +/-2%.
- Q2 FY27 call (Aug 26 2026, per Fool/TIKR/CNBC/search summaries): CFO Kress said non-GAAP GM to decline and bottom in Q4 FY27 at 71%-72%, citing 'extreme pricing conditions in memory'; recovery to 72-73% in FY28 'as executed price increases take effect in Q1'.
- CFO commentary 8-K for Q2 FY27 (SEC) contains no written Q4 GM figure; the 71-72% came from the call.
- Analysts (search summary, Aug 2026): Oppenheimer models Q4 GM ~71.5%; Morgan Stanley views reset as constructive.
- Q3 FY27 earnings expected Nov 17 2026; consensus revenue ~$109B, EPS ~$2.47 (Fool, Nov 1 2026).
- Format pattern: NVIDIA guides GM as midpoint +/-50bp; recent guides show GAAP = non-GAAP.
- Status quo: Q4 guide consistent with the stated 71-72% range.
- Resolves off GAAP GM midpoint in the Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release, rounded to 0.1%; not non-GAAP, not actuals.
- Event window: single release on Nov 17 2026; as of Nov 4 2026 not yet occurred.
- Searched without finding: any post-August update to the Q4 margin view, or memory price developments for Sep-Oct 2026; no prediction market on Q4 GM guidance (Polymarket only covers Q3 actual adjusted GM).

calls.reasoning: On the Aug 26, 2026 Q2 FY27 call, CFO Kress said gross margin bottoms in Q4 FY27 at 71-72% on memory costs, then recovers to 72-73% in FY28. NVIDIA guides one figure +/-50bp, and GAAP equalled non-GAAP in the Q3 guide, so the modal midpoint is 71.5%. Upside: conservative guiding plus an expected Q3 beat (~74.5% vs the 74.0% guide) could support 72.0. Downside: TrendForce sees 10-20% QoQ DRAM increases in 4Q26, possibly beyond NVIDIA's assumptions, so 71.0 or lower is possible; GAAP could also sit 0.1-0.3pt below non-GAAP. Market check: no human market prices the Q4 guide. The Polymarket buckets cover the actual Q3 non-GAAP GM (73-75% at 0.79), a near miss that only confirms Q3 is on plan.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the core fact: a 71-72% Q4 FY27 GM trough verbally guided on the Aug 26 call, each sourced from separate secondary summaries; no run opened the transcript itself, so the quote carries some residual uncertainty, though the summaries agree. They also agree on the point +/-50bp format, and on GAAP=non-GAAP in the Q3 guide. Remaining differences were tail width (1.1 to 1.5) and escape mass, which are judgment calls. Whether the 71-72% applies to non-GAAP only (Run 1) or to both measures could not be settled without the transcript; it is carried as a small downward GAAP skew. TrendForce's 4Q26 memory price rises (Run 2) support some lower-tail weight, and NVIDIA's history of beating its own guides supports upper-tail weight. No web access this run, so I worked from the dossiers alone. Same reference class as the runs; my dispersion matches Run 2's.
